why: record friction met during the populate-context pass

ops.section: 2026-10-17 populate-context: every mod node is aggregator scope, so the leaf-only standards rule matches no node
ops.body: populate-context seeds `standards/` only where the node is not `root` or `aggregator` scope. `ks resolve mods/sweep-zones/src --json` reports `scope: aggregator`, declared in the node's META.md, with the signal "projects.md below the governing node": each mod's projects.md lists its csproj folders (`src/SweepZones`, `src/SweepZones.Tests`), and `ks write plan` labels every mod node `[aggregator]`. Those csproj folders are not nodes, so read literally the rule leaves no node in the store eligible for standards, while `icon-init` gave every mod node a `standards/README.md`. Expected: a node with no child nodes is a leaf for populate-context, or the skill's rule names the deepest node rather than the declared scope. Done instead: landed the three standards documents at all 17 mod nodes, the deepest nodes holding code.
